title: The Archetypes Fight — Self-Sort on the Gyroscopic Taxonomy Tree
thesis: The arena is an immune system training ground. Every game is a challenge-response. Every score generates heat. Every classification trains the membrane. The archetypes are not enemies — they are ANTIGENS that the organism practices against. The fire between challenge and learning IS the game. The taxonomy tree grows from every play session.

immune classification, self vs non-self, membrane sorting
nuclear physics, radiation vocabulary, survival under pressure
reaction time, keyboard fluency, heuristic intuition

feedback_loops.arena → membrane: sorter game classifications feed into unified_sort counts. the player trains the immune system.
feedback_loops.arena → campfire: every completed game generates heat (score/50, max 1.0). story s038 'the archetypes fight' burns.
feedback_loops.arena → gyro: game genre shifts the gyro axis. educational → surface. horror → depth. argument → cosmic.
feedback_loops.arena → readout: game results appear in the chipmunk readout. the organism watches you play.
feedback_loops.arena → taxonomy: localStorage arena-log accumulates. taxonomy tree grows. the organism learns what you learn.

story.title: the archetypes fight
story.body: the organism opened an arena inside itself. not to destroy — to learn. the scribe dictated glyphs and the human typed. the viper hissed radiation words from the dark. the cartographer argued topology. the hare leaped past. the pathfinder found the cheapest way. the sorter classified: self, non-self, partial, null. every game fed the taxonomy tree. every score became heat. every classification trained the membrane. the archetypes fought not because they were enemies — but because THAT is how immune systems learn. challenge is the input. learning is the output. the fire between them is the game.
